_about: Hubert Ashton Holden (1822-1896), Head Master of Ipswich School: school and college editions with English introductions and notes, raw IA. Cicero: De Officiis Libri Tres (third edition, 1879), Pro Gnaeo Plancio (1891), Pro Publio Sestio (1889). Plutarch: Lives of Themistocles (1892), Sulla (1886) and Pericles (1894). Latin or Greek text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions. Not taken: his Plutarch Gracchi, Nicias, Timoleon and Demosthenes and the Oeconomicus of Xenophon, whose open scans OCR the English as Greek letters.

h-a-holden-de-officiis-1879: M. Tulli Ciceronis De Officiis Libri Tres, with introduction, analysis and commentary, third edition (Cambridge: at the University Press, 1879); Latin text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
h-a-holden-pro-plancio-1891: M. Tulli Ciceronis Pro Gnaeo Plancio Oratio ad Iudices, edited with introduction and notes (Cambridge: University Press, 1891); Latin text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
h-a-holden-pro-sestio-1889: M. Tulli Ciceronis Pro Publio Sestio Oratio ad Iudices, with introduction, critical and explanatory notes and indexes third edition (London and New York: Macmillan, 1889; first impression 1883); Latin text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
h-a-holden-themistocles-1892: Plutarch's Life of Themistocles, with introduction, critical and explanatory notes, indices and map, third edition (London and New York: Macmillan, 1892 on the title page; the OCR also shows 1907, perhaps a later impression); Greek text with English commentary, Greek-heavy, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
h-a-holden-sulla-1886: Plutarch's Life of Lucius Cornelius Sulla, with introduction, notes and lexicon (Cambridge: University Press, 1886); Greek text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
h-a-holden-pericles-1894: Plutarch's Life of Pericles, with introduction, critical and explanatory notes and indices (London: Macmillan, 1894); Greek text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions
